external_entities.name: insurance partners
external_entities.description: Three insurance partners that provide daily claim-record extracts.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Three insurance partners drop a daily extract for us.

external_entities.name: analysts
external_entities.description: Analysts who query the warehouse directly.
external_entities.notes: They authenticate with SSO and have a dataset-wide grant; member-identifying columns have not been split out.

processes.name: Airflow scheduler
processes.description: A scheduler that wakes at 02:00, lists the landing bucket, reads files, and triggers a Spark transform job.
processes.source_excerpt: An Airflow scheduler running in the landing network wakes up at 02:00, lists the bucket, and reads whatever is there.
processes.notes: It does not check that a file came from the partner whose folder it landed in.

processes.name: Spark transform job
processes.description: A Spark job that normalizes records and loads them into BigQuery.
processes.source_excerpt: For each file the scheduler triggers a Spark transform job in the warehouse network.
processes.notes: Nothing validates the row contents beyond the schema.

data_stores.name: landing bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket receiving daily extract files from the insurance partners.
data_stores.source_excerpt: They push files into a landing bucket over SFTP.
data_stores.notes: The source says: "I don't know how the landing bucket is encrypted". Both the landing bucket and the Airflow metadata database are on defaults as far as the speaker knows.

data_stores.name: Airflow metadata database
data_stores.description: The Airflow metadata database holding connection strings and partner keys.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Airflow keeps its connection strings and the partner keys in its own metadata database.
data_stores.notes: The source says: "I don't know ... whether the Airflow metadata database is encrypted at rest." Both the landing bucket and the Airflow metadata database are on defaults as far as the speaker knows.

data_stores.name: BigQuery
data_stores.description: The warehouse store containing normalized claim records queried by analysts.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The transform normalizes the records and loads them into BigQuery.
data_stores.notes: Analyst access is dataset-wide; member-identifying columns have not been split out.

data_flows.notes: Nothing validates the row contents beyond the schema.
